face_label_note: Face rates use oct19-face-census.csv, the 27 within-planet pairs, labeled on the same-viewpoint definition. The 60-row face sample in oct19-pairs.csv leaked cross-planet pairs and is not scored.
formula: Planet band rate = labeled planet rows in that band of the stratified sample, divided by the sample count in the band. Headline = sum of band rate times that band's share of all 480 same-section planet pairs. Face rates are the census: each band's share is its count of the 27 within-planet pairs, and the band rate is the labeled rate in that band. unsure is reported alone, held out of yes, and included in yes_or_unsure.

fix1_paraphrase_face.note: Within-planet census pairs with representative cosine >= 0.80 whose posts do not trip local_faces_disagree. Pairs from 0.48 to 0.69 are not resolved.

detail.label: yes
detail.titles: US Ukraine War | US Iran War

fix2_attach_stem.note: Measured fix: both planets under 20 posts, cosine >= 0.55, shared stem ai. A raw specific_stems intersection also joins labeled no pairs; those ids are unsafe_raw_stem_ids and are not removed from the rate.

fix3_keep_dropped_face_posts.note: Unpublished stayed-off posts are not rows in the census. The pair rate does not move.

daypart_planet_gate.note: Either planet is a daypart-majority ball, so the pair is not published.

oct19.rule: Drop the ball when at least half of its representative posts have a daypart greeting in the first 8 words, are at most 60 words, and do not trip _news, _work_topic, or _GREETING_HARD_TOPIC_RE. The tail allowlist is not consulted.
